text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Sigh... I can't stop replaying Tachyon's "Happy birthday" in my head! ♪)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(No way she wished me a happy birthday
at
midnight! Just thinking about it is
enough to keep
me smiling for a week!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...What's the matter, still worked up? All
I did was
wish my dear roommate a
happy birthday.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If that is all it took to get you into this
state, what
would happen if I gave you a
present, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fgweh! Y-you wouldn't! Would you?!
You've
already slain me with your words
alone!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! The way you get stimulated over
such
trivial matters shows incredible
energy
efficiency... How fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, dear Digital! Let us conduct an
experiment
to measure how your
psychosomatic functions
change in
response to your excitement!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! A-an experiment?! You want me
to be your
guinea pig for your
experiment?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait here with bated breath, dear
Digital. I will
return every thirty minutes
to collect data from
your body.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I get to see you every thirty minutes?!
Omigosh!
Somebody pinch meeeee!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaa! Is it really okay for my birthday
to be this
blessed?!
